description: Displayed in the rear courtyard of the Martyrs' Memorial in Royal Jordanian Air Force markings. The museum and Jordanian sources present it as the Hunter flown by Captain Ihsan Shardim at the Battle of Samu on 13 November 1966. Spottingmode identifies the airframe as ex-Royal Air Force Hunter F.4 XF946 construction number HABL003114; the RJAF markings it carries are not its own identity and the two accounts are not reconciled here. Esri imagery of 18 September 2024 shows two aircraft on the memorial plaza but only one is identified in any source found.
